sloka: क्व सीत इति निरीक्षन् वै बाष्प संरुद्धया गिरा ।एवम् उक्ता नरेन्द्रेण ते मृगाः सहसा उत्थिता ॥३-६४-१७॥
transliteration: kva sīta iti nirīkṣan vai bāṣpa saṁruddhayā girā ।evam uktā narendreṇa te mṛgāḥ sahasā utthitā ॥3-64-17॥

translations.english: Thus asked by the prince, all the deer got up suddenly, and pointed towards the southern sky, the direction in which the princess from Mithila was carried off. Looking at the Lord of men (Rama), they started running in that direction.
